about.title: About us
about.heroSubtitle: A community platform built to bring lost pets back to the people who love them.
about.intro: UnLostPaws is where neighbors post, share and spot lost pets so they get home sooner.
about.mission: We believe every lost pet deserves a chance to come home. By combining community alerts, geographic search, and smart photo matching, we make it easier for owners and finders to connect.
about.how1: Post a missing, found, or sighting alert with photos and location details.
about.how2: Browse and filter alerts on the map or listings page to find relevant reports.
about.how3: Our system automatically compares photos and notifies owners when a possible match is found.
about.community: UnLostPaws is built for pet lovers who want to help. Every alert you post or share could be the link that brings a pet home.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heroSubtitle: Quick answers to common questions about posting alerts, photo matching, and using UnLostPaws.
faq.intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Visit our contact page and we'll be happy to help.

items.q: How do I report a lost or found pet?
items.a: Sign in, open Post Alert and follow three steps: describe the pet, add photos and how people can reach you, then pin the location on the map.
Yes. Browsing alerts, posting reports, and receiving match notifications are free for everyone in the community.
When you upload photos, our system analyzes them and compares them against other active alerts. If a possible match is found, we notify the relevant owners.

items.q: Should I trust a match notification?
items.a: Match suggestions are helpful starting points, not guarantees. Always verify in person and use your judgment before taking action.
Location powers map search and nearby alerts. You control when your browser shares location, and photo GPS metadata is only used if you allow it when posting.

items.q: How do I contact someone about an alert?
items.a: Open the alert and tap Show contact info. After a quick security check you'll see the email or phone the poster chose to share.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.heroSubtitle: The rules and responsibilities that keep UnLostPaws safe and trustworthy for everyone.
terms.s1: By using UnLostPaws, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2: You must sign in with a supported social account to post alerts. You are responsible for the accuracy of information you provide.
terms.s3: Alerts must relate to real missing, found, or sighting reports. False, misleading, or spam content may be removed and accounts may be suspended.
terms.s4: Smart matching is provided as a helpful suggestion only. We do not guarantee matches are correct. Always verify in person before taking action.
terms.s5: UnLostPaws is provided as-is. We are not liable for disputes between users or outcomes of reunification efforts.
terms.s6: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heroSubtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information when you use UnLostPaws.
privacy.s1: We collect information you provide when signing in (name, email via OAuth), posting alerts (photos, location, pet details), and using the platform.
privacy.s2: Your data is used to operate the platform, display alerts, run photo matching, and send match notifications. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s3: Location is used for geographic search and map features. You control when location is shared via browser permissions.
privacy.s4: Uploaded photos are checked for duplicates and compared with other alerts. We store a numeric fingerprint of each photo for matching, kept securely.
privacy.s5: Alerts expire automatically. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy.s6: For privacy questions, please use our contact page.
